fields.label: Title
fields.fix: Set experiment.title to a short name for the experiment. You may write this yourself from the goal.

fields.label: Summary
fields.fix: Set experiment.summary to one or two sentences on what was studied.

fields.label: Metadata license
fields.fix: Run: cameo.py fix FILE to set the default (MIT). If the depositor named another, set experiment.license to it; it must be one of: MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-3-Clause, BSD-2-Clause, CC-BY-4.0, CC0-1.0.
fields.bad_msg: choose one of the open licenses CAMEO takes: MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-3-Clause, BSD-2-Clause, CC-BY-4.0, CC0-1.0

fields.label: ORCID
fields.fix: Set experiment.depositor.orcid. Leave it as not_reported if the depositor did not give one.

fields.label: Code link
fields.fix: Set experiment.code_url to the public repository, if there is one.

fields.label: Publication (DOI or link)
fields.fix: Set experiment.publication to a DOI or link, if there is one.

fields.label: Dataset accession
fields.fix: Set experiment.data.accession to the public id of the dataset (for example a Zenodo or GEO id).

json-invalid.fix: Repair the file so that it parses.

json-nonfinite.message: {n} number(s) are Infinity or NaN, which JSON does not allow. The first is on line {line}.
json-nonfinite.fix: Run: cameo.py fix FILE. It records them as diverged.

shape.message: The file needs experiment, models, training and runs at the top level.

no-scored.fix: Each finished run needs performance.score, the number the study optimised.

duplicate-id.fix: Give every model and every run its own id.

dangling-model.message: {n} run(s) name a model that is not in the file
dangling-model.fix: Add the model, or correct runs[].model.

dangling-parent.message: {n} run(s) point to a parent that is not in the file
dangling-parent.fix: Add the parent run, or set history.parent to null.

dangling-recipe.message: {n} run(s) name a training recipe that is not in the file
dangling-recipe.fix: Add the recipe under training, or correct runs[].training.

done-no-score.message: {n} run(s) are marked done but have no score
done-no-score.fix: Give the score, or set performance.status to what happened (failed, invalid).

format.message: The file says format {found}; this kit writes {want}

speed.message: Add inference speed from your own hardware
speed.fix: Run: cameo.py add-speed FILE, on the hardware you want to report.

layers.message: Add layer lists, so model workflows can be drawn

crossover.message: Record both parents of each crossover
crossover.fix: For each run made by combining two lines, set runs[].history.second_parent to {"run": id} or {"lineage": id}.

recipe.fix: Fill the missing details under training.{recipe}. They are listed in the reproduce section of this report.

bad-status.message: {n} run(s) have a status that is not one of: {allowed}
bad-status.fix: Set performance.status to one of the listed values.

dangling-second-parent.message: {n} run(s) name a second parent that is not in the file
dangling-second-parent.fix: history.second_parent is {"run": id} or {"lineage": id}; the id must exist under runs or experiment.search.lineages.

dangling-model-parent.message: {n} model(s) name a parent model that is not in the file
dangling-model-parent.fix: Add the parent model, or set models[].parent to null.

dangling-lineage.message: {n} run(s) name a line of work that is not under experiment.search.lineages
dangling-lineage.fix: Add each line under experiment.search.lineages with its name, family and parents.

recipe-source.fix: Set training.{recipe}.code to {"entry_point": ..., "script": "<the training script as text>"}.

model-source.fix: Store the model file as text under models[].code. It must define build_model().

parameters.message: {n} finished run(s) have no parameter count
parameters.fix: Set performance.parameters to the number of trainable parameters.

runtime.message: {n} finished run(s) have no training time
runtime.fix: Set performance.training_minutes: wall-clock minutes from the start of training to its end.

metrics.message: {n} finished run(s) have no validation or test metrics
metrics.fix: Set performance.valid and performance.test, each a map from metric name to value.

training-context.fix: Set experiment.environment.training_hardware: device (the GPU or CPU model, for example "NVIDIA A100"), count and precision.

speed-some.message: {n} model(s) with a finished run have no inference speed
speed-some.fix: Run: cameo.py add-speed FILE, on the hardware you want to report.

speed-context.message: Inference speed is recorded without its device
speed-context.fix: Set experiment.environment.inference_hardware: device (the GPU or CPU model), threads, batch and precision. cameo.py add-speed writes it.

environment.fix: Set experiment.environment: python, framework and packages, each with its version.

data-split.message: The data split is not shared
data-split.fix: Set experiment.data.splits to an object with how the split was made, plus the code that builds it ("code") or the split files ("files": name → {url, sha256}).

setting.fix: Set {name} under the recipe's settings, or under settings for each run that used its own value.

loss-terms.fix: Set loss.terms to one entry per output: {"output": name, "weight": number}.

loss-reduction.fix: Set loss.reduction, for example "mean over examples, then weighted sum over outputs".

schedule.fix: Under schedules.{name}, give its parameters: start and end rates, warm-up share, and whether it steps per batch or per epoch.

stopping-metric.fix: Set early_stopping.metric and early_stopping.split, or set early_stopping to false if training always runs to the last epoch.

stopping-patience.fix: Set early_stopping.patience, or early_stopping.patience_setting to the name of the setting that holds it.

checkpoint.message: which weights were scored (best or last)
checkpoint.fix: Set checkpoint to "best_validation", "last", or a short description.

shuffle.fix: Set shuffle to true or false.

augmentation.fix: Set augmentation to a list of steps with their parameters, or to "none".

definition.fix: Under definitions.{name}, say in one or two sentences what turning it on does.

init.fix: Set init to "random", or say where the weights came from: {"from": "parent run"} or {"from": "<link to pretrained weights>"}.

source_detail.fix: Set code to {"entry_point": ..., "script": "<the training script as text>"}. With it, a run can be rebuilt exactly.

levels.faithful: Every training detail is recorded; the code is not.

reproducible.label: Reproducible
reproducible.means: The model, its training and the setup are all recorded.

partial.label: Partly reproducible
partial.means: A partial entry. Some of what a rebuild needs is missing.

results-only.label: Results only
results-only.means: No model code is stored, so nothing can be rebuilt.
